note: Security promises made on the sales side, extracted from executed contracts, RFP responses and DPAs. Each is checked against what GRC can actually evidence today.

commitments.text: Vendor shall delete all Customer Data, including backups, within 30 days of termination.
commitments.question: Within how many days of contract termination is customer data deleted, including backups?

commitments.text: Vendor will notify Controller of a confirmed personal data breach without undue delay.
commitments.question: Do you have a documented incident response plan, and within what timeframe are customers notified of a confirmed breach?

commitments.text: Vendor shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all workforce access to production.
commitments.question: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all workforce access to production systems?

commitments.text: Vendor shall commission an independent penetration test at least annually and share the summary on request.
commitments.question: Has an independent penetration test of the application been performed in the last 12 months?

commitments.text: Customer Data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or stronger.
commitments.question: Is customer data encrypted at rest? Specify algorithms and key management.

commitments.text: Acme maintains a 99.99% uptime SLA backed by service credits.
commitments.question: Do you guarantee a 99.99% uptime SLA with financial penalties?
